mapper.select: SELECT '无审退费' AS "name", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM t_t_refund_apply WHERE is_return = 1 AND TRUNC(apply_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT '无审退费' AS "name", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(refund_amount, '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(refund_amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "amount" FROM t_t_refund_apply WHERE is_return = 1 AND TRUNC(apply_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
